CORRECTION to the challenge's exclusivity: neither test is exclusive alone - the same verse-initial bare plural human-group noun stands at 5:3 and 5:8 (sweep: 6 verses in this poem carry that onset: 5:3, 5:8, 5:11, 5:12, 5:13, 5:14), and 5:18 also carries no first-plural form (sweep: 5 verses of 5:1-5:18 carry none: 5:11, 5:12, 5:13, 5:14, 5:18); it is the CONJUNCTION of the two tests that is exclusive, holding in exactly 4 verses, 5:11-5:14, the only consecutive run of any length in the poem (sweep: 4 verses of 22). The unit's own cited texture does not close at 5:11 either: the divine name stands at 5:1, 5:19 and 5:21 and nowhere between (sweep: 3 verses in this poem), so the absence of further direct address runs unbroken through 5:18 and cannot mark a close at 5:11.
